remarks: Bright and charming three-story Colonial tucked away on a convenient cul-de-sac in one of Stamford's most walkable neighborhoods. The thoughtfully designed first floor offers excellent flow for everyday living and entertaining, featuring a living room, den/home office, kitchen, mudroom, full bath, and a dining room with French doors opening to the family room. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms and a full bath, while the finished third-floor attic provides flexible space for a playroom, guest room, or additional office. Hardwood floors, wide baseboard moldings, and 200-amp electrical service add to the home's appeal. Outside, enjoy a beautiful level fenced yard, patio off the family room, detached one-car garage, and ample off-street parking. Ideally located just minutes from both the Glenbrook and Springdale Metro-North stations on the New Canaan Line, offering easy access to New York City. Enjoy the convenience of being within walking distance to neighborhood favorites including a bakery, yoga studio, ice cream shop, pizza restaurants, CVS, grocery shopping, parks, playgrounds, and other local amenities. This home combines classic charm, flexible living space, and an exceptional walkable lifestyle in a prime Stamford location.
